coaching.headline: A draft that lost every lane collapsed at the Outer Tower twice; we won zero fights all night.
coaching.team: Every one of our five lanes read unfavored before the first ward dropped, and the game played out that way: first blood went to The Fey on Steel at 3.7 in the duo lane, and the river went to them 13 times to our 2. We never won a skirmish outright all game -- zero fights won, two tied, five lost -- and Zarus did the damage: three of our four caught-out-alone deaths belonged to him. The 14.8 catch on Renna preceded both the Fangtooth and the first Outer Tower falling at 15.5. The 16.6 catch on Sparrow preceded the second Outer Tower at 17.5. The 17-minute fight that followed was opened a body down, 4 against 5, with Sparrow already dead; it was lost 1-3 and bought the enemy that second tower. Objective damage finished 3,078 to 10,150, towers 0 to 2.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Two solo catches by Zarus -- Renna at 14.8 and Sparrow at 16.6 -- cost both Outer Towers and forced the 17-minute fight 4 against 5, which we lost 1-3.
coaching.whatWorked: Sparrow was the one player who answered: 4 kills on 2 deaths, including picks on The Fey and GRIM.exe, on a build 2 of 3 core items deep.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

Play against Zarus: Barricade only blocks from the front, so hit him from the side or behind and dodge its swing stun; disengage during Coliseum's doubled-power window, and buy armor and anti-heal
